Once you clarify, I can help set it up via one of these approaches on Windows:
- **PATH** — Add to system environment variables via registry/settings
- **Batch wrapper** — Create a `.bat` script in `C:\Windows` or similar system folder
- **PowerShell function** — Add to system PowerShell profile (machine-level instead of user-level)
